title: Improved Nonlinearity for Differentially 4-Uniform Permutations
summary: The known nonlinearity benchmark for differentially 4-uniform permutations on 2n bits may not be optimal; whether any such permutation exceeds it remains open.

formal_statement.body: For differentially $4$-uniform permutations on $2n$ bits, the best known nonlinearity is $2^{2n-1}-2^n$. Determine whether there exists such a permutation $F$ satisfying $\operatorname{NL}(F)>2^{2n-1}-2^n$.

scope.domain: Vectorial Boolean functions, specifically the nonlinearity of differentially 4-uniform permutations in even bit dimension.
parameters: n: determines the bit dimension 2n of the permutation
F: the candidate differentially 4-uniform permutation whose nonlinearity is compared with the benchmark
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether any such permutation has nonlinearity strictly greater than the best-known value.

citations.label: Cryptanalysis of a Theorem: Decomposing the Only Known Solution to the Big APN Problem

progress.summary: The paper recalls this as an earlier explicit open problem, describing the stated nonlinearity as the best known and asking whether any function in the target class can improve it.
citation_labels: Léo Perrin et al., Cryptanalysis of a Theorem: Decomposing the Only Known Solution to the Big APN Problem
